snippet.title: Wild Blue Skies | Official Release Date Trailer | Balor Games
snippet.description:
Take to the skies on August 13!

As Bowie Stray, you'll lead a squadron of pilots through high-speed dogfights, master responsive on-rails combat, and uncover the secrets of a world under siege. From Chuhai Labs, Wild Blue Skies is the definitive modern evolution of the classic arcade rail-shooter. 

Coming to Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.
